Formula

value = (gold price per troy ounce ÷ 31.1034768) × grams × fineness × exchange rate × (1 + premium ÷ 100)

Gold uses the troy ounce, not the everyday avoirdupois ounce. One troy ounce equals exactly 31.1034768 grams. Purity reduces gross weight to estimated fine-gold content.

What this estimate does not include

A real dealer quote may include bid-ask spread, fabrication premium, assay or refining costs, taxes, shipping, payment fees and local supply conditions.

The scheduled close can differ from a live spot quote. Confirm the current price and product terms with a broker or bullion dealer before a transaction.

Frequently asked questions

How do I calculate gold price per gram?

Divide the price per troy ounce by 31.1034768. Then multiply by the number of grams and the item's purity as a decimal.

Is 22K gold pure gold?

No. Twenty-two-karat gold is approximately 91.67% pure. The remaining metal is an alloy added for color, strength or workability.

Is this a dealer quote?

No. It is an educational metal-value estimate. A dealer's executable price can be higher or lower after spreads, premiums, taxes and fees.
